checks.name: event_failure_rolls_back_order
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from outbox import create_order,pending_events
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');create_order(db,'first',1);db.execute("CREATE TRIGGER reject_event BEFORE INSERT ON outbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'down'); END")
try:create_order(db,'second',2)
except sqlite3.DatabaseError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('trigger failure ignored')
assert db.execute("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id='second'").fetchone() is None and pending_events(db)==[{'id':'first','amount':1}]

checks.name: duplicate_has_no_extra_event
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from outbox import create_order,pending_events
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');create_order(db,'one',1)
try:create_order(db,'one',2)
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('duplicate accepted')
assert pending_events(db)==[{'id':'one','amount':1}]

checks.name: insertion_order_and_valid_amount
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from outbox import create_order,pending_events
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');create_order(db,'b',2);create_order(db,'a',1)
assert pending_events(db)==[{'id':'b','amount':2},{'id':'a','amount':1}]
try:create_order(db,'bad',0)
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('zero amount')
